## Checklist

- [ ] `php artisan test` passes, and new behavior has a test.
- [ ] No migration drops or rewrites data, or: it has a working `down()`, and what happens to existing data is written below.
- [ ] No new third-party service, API or remote asset.
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` values or real people's data.
- [ ] Nothing that needs a store release (`hype.toml`, icons, splash, permissions).
